components.name: Primary Reveal Button
components.description: A compact, high-contrast action used when revealing the contact address.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-block-size: 44px; min-inline-size: 44px; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; font: 300 0.85rem/1.5 "Source Serif 4", serif; color: var(--color-button-text, #fff); background: var(--color-button-bg, #0069d9); border: 1px solid var(--color-button-bg, #0069d9); border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { color: var(--color-button-text, #fff); background: var(--color-button-bg-hover, #0056b3); border-color: var(--color-button-bg-hover, #0056b3); text-decoration: underline; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #0069d9); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Theme Toggle
components.description: A quiet footer action that reveals its underline on interaction.
components.css: .ds-button-ghost { min-block-size: 44px; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; font: 300 0.85rem/1.5 "Source Serif 4", serif; color: var(--color-text-light, #1a1a1a); background: none; border: 0; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: transparent; transition: text-decoration-color 0.3s ease; } .ds-button-ghost:hover, .ds-button-ghost:active { text-decoration-color: var(--color-accent-hover, #0056b3); } .ds-button-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #0069d9); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Primary Navigation
components.description: A centered, wrapping text index with a precise current-page underline.
components.html: HomePortfolioWriting
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; gap: 0 1rem; background: var(--color-bg-header, #f2efe9); } .ds-nav-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-block-size: 44px; min-inline-size: 44px; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; color: var(--color-text-light, #1a1a1a); font: 600 1rem/1.5 "Source Serif 4", serif; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.3s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--color-accent-hover, #0056b3); text-decoration: underline; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { color: var(--color-accent, #0069d9); outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #0069d9); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-current { text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 2px; text-underline-offset: 0.4em; }

components.name: Post Card
components.description: The signature project and writing index row: image, title, summary, and quiet section mark.
components.html:
A research project

A concise description keeps the index scannable.

(portfolio)
components.css: .ds-post-card { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 150px 1fr; gap: 0 1.25rem; align-items: start; padding: 1.25rem; color: var(--color-text-primary, #1a1a1a); background: var(--color-bg-card, #f2efe9); border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #e0e0e0); border-radius: 8px; font: 300 1.2rem/1.5 "Source Serif 4", serif; transition: border-color 0.3s ease; } .ds-post-card:hover { border-color: var(--color-border-hover, #0069d9); } .ds-post-card:focus-within { border-color: var(--color-border-hover, #0069d9); outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #0069d9); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-post-thumb { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1; border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #e0e0e0); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--color-bg-body, #faf7f2); } .ds-post-copy h2 { margin: 0 0 1.25rem; font-size: 1.25rem; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-post-copy a { color: var(--color-text-primary, #1a1a1a); text-decoration: none; } .ds-post-copy a:hover { color: var(--color-accent-hover, #0056b3); text-decoration: underline; } .ds-post-copy p { margin: 0 0 1.5rem; } .ds-post-copy span { display: block; margin-top: 0.5rem; color: var(--color-text-muted, #4a4a4a); text-align: right; } @media (max-width: 768px) { .ds-post-card { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } .ds-post-thumb { margin-bottom: 1.25rem; } }

components.name: Annotated Quotation
components.description: A semantic margin-like annotation made from italic graphite text and one signal rule.
components.html: A useful quotation or technical aside belongs to the argument, not to decoration.
components.css: .ds-blockquote { margin: 0 0 1.5rem; padding-left: 1rem; color: var(--color-text-muted, #4a4a4a); border-left: 3px solid var(--color-accent, #0069d9); font: italic 300 1.2rem/1.5 "Source Serif 4", serif; }

components.name: Code Block
components.description: A bordered, internally scrolling technical inset that never widens the reading column.
components.css: .ds-code-block { overflow-x: auto; margin: 0 0 1.5rem; padding: 1rem; color: var(--color-text-primary, #1a1a1a); background: var(--color-bg-body, #faf7f2); border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #e0e0e0); border-radius: 8px; } .ds-code-block code { padding: 0; background: none; border: 0; font: 0.95rem/1.5 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; } .ds-code-block:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #0069d9); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
The site should feel like opening a careful research notebook: warm, legible, personal, and quietly technical. Source Serif 4 gives ideas the authority of print without making the portfolio feel ceremonial. Paper-toned surfaces, light rules, and generous reading space let projects and writing carry the page.

The system is deliberately restrained. A single signal color handles navigation, links, focus, and action in the light theme; a warm reading glow takes that role at night. Components are structurally explicit and quietly tactile rather than glossy, ornamental, or application-like.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper surfaces with ink-like serif typography.
One scarce signal color per theme.
Flat, border-defined depth with no shadows.
Comfortable prose measures and compact, scannable indexes.
Motion limited to state communication and disabled for reduced-motion users.
Light, dark, and system-following themes with equal visual authority.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Use Signal Blue in light mode and Reading Gold in dark mode for links, focus, and action. Do not introduce a competing accent.

rules.name: The Paired Theme Rule
rules.body: Every semantic color change must be defined for the light default, system-dark mode, and explicit dark override. An explicit light choice continues to inherit the light default.

rules.name: The Single Voice Rule
rules.body: Use weight, size, spacing, and italics to create hierarchy before introducing another typeface.

rules.name: The Reading Measure Rule
rules.body: Indexes may use the full `100ch` container; prose must use the narrower `45rem` article measure.

rules.name: The Content-First Collapse Rule
rules.body: At narrow widths, remove floats and side-by-side card geometry before reducing readable type or touch targets.

rules.name: The Flat Notebook Rule
rules.body: Depth comes from tonal surfaces and structural borders. Do not add ambient shadows to cards, navigation, controls, or article media.

rules.name: The Quiet Corner Rule
rules.body: Use `8px` for content containers, `4px` for compact controls, and no radius for text navigation. Never use pills as decoration.

dos: Do use semantic CSS variables for every themed color and update the light default, system-dark declaration, and explicit dark declaration together.
Do keep Source Serif 4 local, variable, Latin-subset, and loaded with `font-display: swap`.
Do preserve 44px interaction targets and visible `:focus-visible` outlines.
Do keep article prose near 70–75 characters and let indexes use the wider grid.
Do use responsive Hugo page resources with intrinsic dimensions, WebP sources, and JPEG fallbacks.
Do honor `prefers-reduced-motion` and preserve core reading access without JavaScript.
donts: Don't hard-code themed colors in component rules; use the established semantic variables.
Don't add shadows, glossy gradients, decorative pills, or extra accent colors.
Don't remove focus indicators, shrink touch targets, or communicate state through color alone.
Don't use inline scripts or inline styles in Hugo templates; the strict CSP requires external scripts and class-based styling.
Don't edit vendored LaTeXML stylesheets for site-specific changes; use `static/css/latexml/site.css`.
Don't repeat nearby link text in thumbnail alternatives; decorative card thumbnails use empty alt text, while meaningful article images use page-resource metadata.
